query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec), (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected<>'' WITH DISTINCT r,cr,hub.specNumber AS specNumber,rel UNWIND split(cr.clausesAffected,',') AS rawClause WITH r,cr,specNumber,rel,trim(rawClause) AS clause MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(edition:Spec) WHERE edition.specNumber=specNumber AND edition.specRelease=rel.releaseName AND s.sectionNumber=clause RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId,cr.tdocNumber AS crTdoc,clause,s.sectionId AS sectionId
